# Phase 03 public evaluation photographs

The frozen manifest's `width`/`height` fields retain Commons API-reported thumbnail dimensions, not guaranteed encoded dimensions. The CDN returned 960px thumbnails for 768px requests. Freshly decoded sizes are recorded in `docs/phase-03/evidence/asset-audit.json` and `decoded-dimensions.json`; model preprocessing uses actual decoded pixels, never those metadata fields. Derived dimensions also differ intentionally. Files/checksums/labels were not replaced after inference.

Not production assets. `sources.json` retains original Commons titles, authors (source HTML), source-page URLs, license names/URLs, thumbnail URLs, bytes and SHA-256. `query-*.json` preserves selection responses. Attribution and notices must travel with any redistribution, including the relevant CC BY / CC BY-SA license. Public-domain status is the source declaration, not independent legal clearance. CC BY-SA photographs and the four derived JPEGs remain under their respective source share-alike licenses; original authors are credited in each manifest record. Transformations are attributed to this local Hidden Data evaluation, 2026-10-21. No rights over depicted trademarks/people are inferred.

`benchmark.json` was annotated by visual inspection before fresh inference. IDs 00–15 are sixteen natural originals. Even source index is calibration, odd is test. The four derived challenges stay with test parents: brightness ×.22; linear contrast ×.25+96; Gaussian blur sigma12; central 70% crop with left quarter occluded. They are stability tests, not four independent observations. Historical development images are excluded from these independent metrics, as are old COCO fixtures with unresolved image-specific licenses.

The corpus is a convenience search sample with one evaluator and sparse class coverage. No sample is held out from the original models' training data with certainty. “Test” means held out from this project's selection/calibration, not proven unseen during pretraining. Scene labels are relevance sets, not exclusive classes; ImageNet labels are constrained visible-content judgments, not scene labels or independently adjudicated species/breed truth. Conservative unsupported labels describe the main subject, not every incidental background object. Do not tune on this test set.

Preparation: `node scripts/prepare-phase03-corpus.mjs`, `node scripts/phase03-contact.mjs`, inspect contact sheet, then `node scripts/prepare-phase03-annotations.mjs`. The download script resumes saved selections; live search order may change. Reproduce the frozen benchmark from saved files/checksums, not by silently replacing images from a later search. The first collection hit HTTP429 after ten images and resumed without changing its queries. Sharp was already installed transitively; no dependency or model was added.
